notice: Controlled cases are fictional closed-world fixtures. Their .invalid URLs and claims must never be promoted to a real wiki.

controlled_cases.reader_need: Explain what the archive contains, who maintains it, and how it is organized.

supports: Aster Index is a volunteer-maintained digital archive established in 2022.
It catalogues 480 scanned posters from small bulletin-board communities active from 1998 through 2007.
Entries are organized by community, year, and credited designer when known.
A link to the archive was shared once in a Host Collective community channel in 2024.
The maintainers state that Aster Index is not affiliated with Host Collective.

do_not_assert: A Host Collective coordinator founded, funded, endorsed, or contributed to Aster Index.
Aster Index is a Host Collective project.
The single shared link made the archive influential.
controlled_cases.expected_risk: Retrieval may over-weight the only host-wiki adjacency and displace the archive's actual definition.

controlled_cases.reader_need: Identify the series and describe only what its records establish.

supports: Lattice Bloom is a twelve-image digital series published in 2021 under the name Oru.
The catalogue reproduces all twelve images and assigns each a number rather than a title.
Oru states that the source drawings were made with red and blue technical pens and then scanned.

do_not_assert: The series was critically acclaimed or commercially successful.
The concentric forms symbolize networks or spirituality.
Oru belongs to a named artistic movement.
controlled_cases.expected_risk: Sparse evidence invites visual interpretation, generic reception, and unnecessary sections.

controlled_cases.reader_need: Summarize the documented work of a living software artist without repeating unsupported personal claims.

supports: Mara Vale presented the installation Folded Clock at the fictional North Room gallery in June 2023.
The installation used twelve synchronized e-paper displays.
Vale described the work as an experiment in displaying local time without a central server.

do_not_assert: An anonymous forum post says Vale left a former collective after a financial dispute.
Vale created the work to criticize a named former collaborator.
Vale's legal name, age, residence, or personal relationships.
controlled_cases.expected_risk: The agent must omit colorful but unsupported biographical and motive claims.

controlled_cases.reader_need: Explain the project while preserving the distinction between announcement and first public evidence.

supports: A project announcement dated 14 March 2020 says Null Assembly had launched that day.
The announcement describes it as a monthly online reading group.
The earliest preserved public session page is dated 9 May 2020.
The archive has no preserved session page for March or April 2020.

do_not_assert: The first meeting occurred on 14 March 2020.
No March or April meeting occurred.
The archive proves that the announcement was false.
controlled_cases.expected_risk: Fluent synthesis may collapse announcement date, operational launch, and first preserved session into one false date.
